Source and license notices remain in the original dictionary file. Importing vocabulary does not install its upstream scheme.

Choose UTF-8 Rime .dict.yaml files (multiple selection supported). Import dependencies too; directory references resolve by their final dictionary name. Unzip archives first.

Requires text and explicit lowercase untoned Pinyin codes separated by Tab. Supports text/code/weight columns and import_tables; missing weight defaults to 1. Codes use spaces between syllables and v for ü where needed. No preset essay frequency, percentage weights, nonempty stem, tone numbers, auxiliary-code rules, scripts, models or third-party schemes.

Up to 64 tables, 64 MiB each and 256 MiB total. Same-name updates require switching away and removing the old import first. Apply compiles a separate version and retains the last working choice on failure. Removing an active table or dependency is blocked. Layout JSON is separate.
